notes.title: Difficulty Counter
notes.notes:
Hey

I've noticed your incredible feats at conquering Level 20 over and over again. You asked for more challenge, and it's here.

New Feature: The Difficulty Counter!

Every time you beat Level 20, the Difficulty Counter ticks up by 1, making enemies tougher and even bringing elite foes into the fray.

Tougher Enemies: As the counter increases, so does the challenge.
Elite Enemies: A higher counter means a chance to face off against elite enemies.

Note: If you've unlocked the Boomerang Meow, you’ll start with a Difficulty Counter of 1 as a head start to ramping up the challenge!

This update is our way of saying thanks for your dedication.
Ready to test your limits?

Cheers,
Doonutsaur
